verdict.reasons: Core identity is strong: the correct single upright cylindrical AFP drip-tape carton roll is clearly visible with authentic 'Drip Irrigation Tape under AFP' and owner-approved Persian blue water-drop caption. The irrigation laterals shown are appropriate installed thin drip tape supporting the agronomy context. The required watermark 'AFP | 09134922013' is present. No wrong family, fake text, collage, people, or impossible geometry are observed. Minor advisory notes only: the bottom Persian text wraps/deterministically follows the cylinder and some tiny secondary fine print is not perfectly legible, but these are not core defects.

focused_physical_review.reason: The full frame and detail crops show a continuous black irrigation line running along the crop rows in the background, passing several inches behind the white-and-blue AFP carton. The soil around the carton's footprint is clear of the line, with a visible gap. No distinct, separate loose coil or roll is present outside the main package. No white ribbon, strap, or tape tail is visibly protruding from the carton's sides or base.
